title: CLI shows `gemini-2.5-pro (x% context left)` even after a flash fallback
body: ### What happened? ### What did you expect to happen? The bottom bar text should say the current active model name. ### Client information Built from HEAD ### Login information Google Account ### Anything else we need to know? However it isn't clear to me what the intent of that message is. For pro model it seems to represent the max context size a request can have, and the context growth as users interact with the CLI. Does the same context limitation apply for the Flash model? Is it the same limit?
